habitat: SABAP1 says it prefers broadleaved woodland and savanna, and also uses thornveld, riparian woodland and plantations. Wikipedia gives subtropical or tropical dry forest, dry savanna and dry shrubland.
summary: No Newman page. SABAP1 calls it a nondescript, inconspicuous bird, usually single or in pairs, and largely arboreal. The call is the best way to detect it and is not described. Wikipedia names the habitats and gives no plumage. The atlas uses Petronia superciliaris. This file keeps Gymnoris superciliaris. No length, plumage or status is stored. The Kemp paper name Yellowthroated Sparrow and the code RB were left unchanged.

calls.description: SABAP1 says the call is not particularly distinctive and does not transcribe it. Wikipedia does not describe the voice. Grade A call from Klerksdorp, North West. No openly licensed Kruger grade A call outranked it. The filename is XC421072-NG Kerk camp grounds 19.6.2018.mp3.
